title: Top 3 Revenue Drivers
scenario: Retrieve the top 3 products by revenue within each category.
tableSchema: inventory (prod_id INT, cat_id INT, revenue NUMERIC)
hint: Use DENSE_RANK() to account for ties.
correctQuery: SELECT cat_id, prod_id, revenue FROM (SELECT cat_id, prod_id, revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY cat_id ORDER BY revenue DESC) as rnk FROM inventory) t WHERE rnk <= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE inventory (prod_id INT, cat_id INT, revenue NUMERIC);
